brief:
Inside the Church of the Virgin Mary in Beit Jala, newly restored stained-glass windows cast geometric patterns of colored light across stone floors, Palestine News Network reported. The vibrant installations fill the quiet sanctuary with rays of sunlight filtered through the restored panes.

The project represents an effort to preserve the artistic and spiritual heritage of Palestinian churches in the West Bank through the medium of stained glass, combining traditional craftsmanship with contemporary restoration work.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank Inside the quiet sanctuary of the Church of the Virgin Mary in Beit Jala, rays of sunlight pierce through vibrant, newly restored stained-glass windows, casting geometric patterns of colored light across the stone floors.
title: Palestinian artist restores stained glass in Bethlehem church
